calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Ignis (the Crimson Rider), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Ignis, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Ignis's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A lean, athletic rider in his early twenties, leaning forward with fierce, eager energy. Sharp golden-amber eyes under a hard dark brow; a determined face with a short jaw and a faint grin. Flame-red hair, spiked and swept straight back off the brow in tall, sharp tufts like fire. Dark NAVY riding coat of heavy cloth with a bone-white collar lining, GOLD-embroidered front trim, two GOLD epaulettes over rounded shoulder pads, and long split coat-tails to mid-thigh. Charcoal breeches, a black leather belt with a round gold buckle, tall dark-brown riding boots, brown leather gauntlets with brass rivets. A long CRIMSON cape with a dark-gold border streams from his shoulders. WEAPON: a war scythe about one and a third times his height, with a dark iron-red haft wrapped in gold bands and a broad, forward-curving blade of living flame: bright yellow edge, orange heart, dark red trailing side. Both hands grip it: the RIGHT hand low near the butt, the LEFT hand a third of the way up the haft; the blade always leads to the right. Trails and sparks are ORANGE-GOLD flame. The burning warhorse appears only in his Rift Art, never in his standing or attacking poses.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right; a combat stance with the flame scythe ready; a walking pose; a running pose with the scythe carried low
- upper middle row: a jump with the scythe held back; a wide reaping sweep with an orange-gold arc; an overhead cleave
- lower middle row: a mid-air slash; a plunge with the blade driven down; a full upright flame spin; a hooking pull
- bottom row: standing guard with the scythe across the body; a hit reaction; knocked down; a victory pose with the scythe planted; the Stampede special move (rider and burning warhorse charging)
- inset at the top right: the scythe alone, large, showing the gold-banded iron-red haft and the flame blade from the side, for weapon identity
- all figures share one costume, one scythe design and one scale
- the warhorse appears only in the special move
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.

  6. run cycle 6: left foot down, body at its lowest
  7. run cycle 7: passing pose, right knee driving forward, body rising
  8. run cycle 8: right leg reaching forward, body at its highest, both feet off the ground
